'''Deni Colford''' is a member of the [[Queen's Guards]]. 

== Appearance ==
She has black hair that is graying, a placid face, strong arms and wide shoulders. She is blocky and about 5'6 tall. 

She had no concept of fighting fair. Originally, she was adept with a pace-long, brass-studded cudgel but could not handle a sword. She improved after taking lessons.

== Activities ==
She is one of the first eight of the Queens's Guards placed as a bodyguard when [[Elayne Trakand]] moves through [[Caemlyn]] to greet the people. She was a former bouncer in a tavern for wagon drivers in Low Caemlyn, a very unusual job for a woman.

She is assigned one of Elayne's guards, when Elayne arrives back from touring around all the minor Houses of Andor.

She escorts Elayne to the meeting with [[Dyelin Taravin]] and the other [[High Seat]]s based in Caemlyn.
When [[Daved Hanlon]] is captured and made prisoner, she and the other bodyguards pummel him severely.
